title: Louisiana-Style Crayfish Tail Stew with Rice
summary: Sweet crayfish tails in a rich, gently spiced sauce built on a nutty butter roux with onion, green pepper and celery, served over fluffy rice. Finished with spring onions, parsley and a splash of hot sauce.

ingredients.item: cooked peeled crayfish tails (frozen, thawed in the fridge), with any juices
fish stock or low-salt chicken broth (check stock label for celery)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the roux
steps.text: Melt the butter in the casserole over medium-low heat, whisk in the flour and keep stirring for 8-10 minutes. It is ready when it reaches the colour of peanut butter and smells nutty. Turn the heat down if it darkens too quickly, because a burnt roux tastes bitter and has to be started again.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Add the onion, green pepper and celery and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until soft. Stir in the garlic, tomato purée, paprika, cayenne, thyme, bay leaves and pepper for 1 minute. The hot roux toasts the spices briefly, which brings out their aroma.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Whisk in the stock a little at a time so the sauce stays smooth, then add the salt. Simmer gently, uncovered, for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until it coats the back of a spoon. Adding liquid gradually lets the roux absorb it evenly, which prevents lumps.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Meanwhile, rinse the rice until the water runs clear and put it in the saucepan with the 450ml water. Bring to the boil, cover, cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes, then rest off the heat for 10 minutes. Leaving the lid on throughout traps the steam that finishes the grains.

steps.title: Add the crayfish
steps.text: Stir in the crayfish tails with their juices and most of the spring onions, then simmer for 4-5 minutes until piping hot, at least 74°C, since the tails are already cooked. If using raw prawns, simmer for the same time until pink and opaque. Adding the shellfish last stops it turning rubbery; stir in the parsley and taste for seasoning.

steps.title: Serve over rice
steps.text: Spoon the stew over the rice and scatter with the remaining spring onions. Serve with lemon wedges and hot pepper sauce at the table.

tips: A common mistake is rushing the roux over high heat, which scorches it; patience at medium-low gives a deep, nutty colour without bitterness.
Have all the vegetables chopped before you start the roux, as it needs constant stirring.
Thaw frozen crayfish tails in the fridge and keep their juices, which add flavour to the sauce.
storage: Cool within 2 hours, refrigerate and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently on the hob, stirring, until piping hot (74°C); add a splash of water if the sauce has thickened.
